changelog:
Initial release of Discovery Call Prep Skill

- Generates a comprehensive, structured brief for discovery/sales calls.
- Includes company and contact research, call hypothesis, agenda, targeted questions, and success criteria.
- Provides best practices, quality checks, and anti-patterns to improve call effectiveness.
- Supports flexible call durations and customizable next steps.
- Example trigger phrases for ease of use.
